about: Homepage stage promotions per locale (tools/importer/stage-promotions.mjs). 'homepage-stage': the stage of the imported homepage (live .mainstageteaser, link mode). 'card': a stage built from an existing teaser card of the same homepage (its image, eyebrow, title, text and link). start / end: as authored in the Section Metadata (market time; a date alone is the whole day). FLYZA ends with its booking period on the de pages ('Use code FLYZA before October 31, 2026', /de/en/local-page/south-africa-winter-promotion); the other second promotions start on 2026-12-01 so the homepages match www until then.
